label: EK TARFA
line1: Patta patta boota boota haal hamara jaane hai,
line2: jaane na jaane gul hi na jaane, baagh to saara jaane hai.
author: Mir Taqi Mir

label: KHWAHISHEN
line1: Hazaron khwahishen aisi ke har khwahish pe dam nikle,
line2: bahut nikle mere armaan lekin phir bhi kam nikle.
author: Mirza Ghalib
